svg.title: The Gomu Gomu snake devours the contribution graph
svg.desc: A GitHub-style contribution calendar for the last year with 679 contributions over 57 active days. Colour shows intensity, from pale for quiet days through gold to crimson for the busiest. A short gold snake wearing a straw hat slithers out of the left margin, eats every active day week by week, and leaves on the right while the grid regrows. One lap takes about 22 seconds.
svg.text: 57 active days · best day 63 on Oct 29 · longest streak 5 days, Aug 17–21
